prompts.oblique: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: in-game pixel-art backdrop for a Soul Knight-like 2.5D action arena. Image1 is the existing arena to improve; Image2 is atmosphere reference. Create ONE atlas with TWO EQUAL panels stacked vertically: top colored courtyard, bottom SAME courtyard near-monochrome during time stop. Keep logical arena broad5:3, atlas portrait5:6. CRITICAL change from overhead: oblique2.5D view, looking down about55degrees, visible FRONT FACES and shallow height on stone boundaries, tiled floor foreshortened in depth, rear gothic wall with a low readable vertical face. Similar to Soul Knight gameplay, NOT a side-view or cinematic isometric diagonal diamond, and NOT directly top-down flat tiles. Rectangular navigable arena fills panel, no perspective vanishing point. CENTRAL85% must stay CLEAR, EMPTY, low-contrast stone paving so gameplay collision walls can be drawn separately. Northern low wall and edge gothic trim have bevels, dark front faces, tiny lamps; subtle tiny warm lights and pink ivy only at outer perimeter. Add minimal natural ambient-occlusion beneath edge stonework, no giant interior pillars or stairs. Color teal slate paving, cool indigo shadows, muted burgundy flowers and restrained magenta anomaly near one edge. Bottom panel exact SAME geometry but mostly gray/cold desaturated. No people, no enemies, no props in central arena, no UI/text/grid overlay. Crisp cohesive pixel art, calm floor, restrained neon accents, shallow dimensionality, readable playable asset, not a concept collage. Match both panels tightly so swapping them does not reposition the arena.
prompts.attacks: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: GAME-READY PIXEL-ART ANIMATED NEON COMBAT VFX atlas, true transparent background. Reference is mood only. ONE clean atlas with6 EQUAL columns x3 EQUAL rows, exactly18 separate frames. Every cell same square canvas and anchor. No actors, no weapons, no UI/text/grid/background, no fireworks, confetti, stars or exploding particles. Soul Knight-like shallow2.5D combat effects, readable at64-128 game pixels. ROW1 SIX FRAMES of a single elegant hero sword slash aimed RIGHT: bright razor-thin white core with CYAN electric rim, crescent sweep, blue translucent trailing ribbon; frames buildup / sweep-start / full strong CRESCENT / follow-through / fading curved trail / almost disappeared thin wisp. Blade energy sweeps along a shallow oblique ground plane, not a flat perfect circle; dynamic tapered shape with slight depth and a darker-blue underside. Keep fixed center every frame. ROW2 SIX FRAMES of temporal pulse: thin brilliant cyan WHITE-CORE ELLIPTICAL ground shockwave expanding from center, two elegant concentric energy ribbons, minimal tiny short dashes embedded in ring, not an explosion or firework. First small ring, then expanding flattened oval, last dissolves. ROW3 SIX FRAMES of an enemy MAGIC BOLT aimed RIGHT: sharp hot-magenta/plum needle with white core and a sleek short tapered magenta vapor tail, subtle pulse in brightness across frames, constant center and silhouette size. Clear contrast cyan=player magenta=enemy. All effects strongly luminous neon but preserve crisp stepped pixel edges, no diffuse fog blob, no oversized halos. Each row consistent exact6-frame sequence. Uniform generous cell margins, no overlaps, all art within its own cell. Suitable to slice by equal grid, all original hero sprites will stay unchanged.

notes: Oblique 2.5D illustration and animated neon effects. Physics remain on the 2D collision plane; shadows, raised front faces and foot-position sorting create depth.
